scope: One fixed validation case, prediction-blind manual target/control timeline assessment. V3 automatic NDVI eligibility remains false. No dataset export, label lock, inference or accuracy in this task.

pair.label_interpretation: New annotated loss between observations; zero is not verified no-change

selection.candidate_rule: Exact previously fixed V3 candidate; no V1/V2/V3 retuning. This review is separate from V3 automatic eligibility.
selection.selection_bias: One geometry/quality-filtered convenience case in one validation group. No population accuracy claim.

rule.control_search_order: Scan sizes16/12/8 largest first, ascending row then column. Select first QA/finite/exclusion-safe square, reserve its entire radius2 context, continue same order until3 or exhausted. No NDVI threshold, visual class or prediction enters selection.

review.acceptance: Whole anchor target unambiguously forest at fixed pre endpoint and clearing at fixed post endpoint, plus at least one later clear clearing observation; no later clear forest contradiction. Minimum4 original eroded interior pixels. First locked control with whole ROI unambiguous forest at BOTH endpoints plus at least one later clear stable-forest date (>=3 distinct dates), no definite nonforest/change on any other clear date. All definite target/control claims require full radius2 QA-clear and finite RGB/NDVI context; both endpoint contexts additionally have finite original27 features.
review.uncertainty: Seasonal/phenological colour, agriculture, roads, bare ground, thin/mixed forest or spatial ambiguity are not unambiguous forest-to-clearing evidence. Retain uncertain/obscured dates; do not invent states for missing evidence. Assistant review is not expert ground truth.
review.control_choice: Review all precommitted candidates and dates, then retain first qualifying candidate in original order. Never redraw/shrink/add controls after inspection. If none qualifies, reject entire case; no negative-only labels from rejected cases.
review.first_visible_interval: If evidence supported, last clear forest date before first clear clearing date defines (last forest, first visible clearing], with all intervening obscured/uncertain observations retained. Windowed observation interval, not exact felling or global first-event date.

cache_preparation.missing_cache_policy: Compute exactly the four missing observations with the unchanged frozen QA/cloud policy inside one guarded CPU worker; retain all12 dates. Each missing QA observation reads11 union-band windows (seven include-feature requests for per-date RGB/NDVI and validity), total44 fused/28 include-feature requests and4 cloud-model calls. No forest model or re-extraction of the endpoint27-channel feature stack. Fail rather than call an extant usable scene unavailable merely because cache was absent.

timeline_window.interpretation: Local windowed observation evidence; not a global first-clearing claim

limitations: Review and control roster deliberately bounded; rejection is an allowed result.
V3 automatic no-control result stays negative and unchanged.
QA flags and NDVI are not class truth; assistant inspection is not independent expert annotation.
Only the exact frozen tiny CNN has the proved radius2 input contract.
Later supporting images use cached QA/finite RGB/NDVI; all27 finite feature proof belongs to the fixed endpoint pair.
No approved labels or unseen-location accuracy follows from preparing or reviewing images.
